referenceIdentityNote: Identity supplied by founder in EP6-P5E-R Phase 4B authorization (2026-08-12). Phase 4A incorrectly attributed Ani to 'Parfums de Marly'. Correction: Nishane — Ani. Nishane is a Turkish niche house.
